title: Elite: First Choir Lock: Hidden Law
description: First Choir Lock unfolds across choir vault ascent with bone-white arches, bells, and sanctified stairs, pushing a 5-Titan Empyrean squad to prove protection, order-locks, shields, anti-chaos control, formationless aura play. without violating established Realm canon.
lore: First Choir Lock: Hidden Law advances Empyrean Choir Vault: The Radiant Hierarchies ascend a broken heaven-engine where order can stabilize worlds or erase dissonant survivors. It directly tests the faction tension: Their mercy is real, but so is their judgment. Allies fear becoming evidence in an Empyrean trial.
terrain: choir vault ascent with bone-white arches, bells, and sanctified stairs

objectives.primary: Cleanse the Gate wound without breaking Empyrean realm law. Elite remix: complete it while the secondary hazard condition is active.
optional: Resolve at least three Empyrean doctrine actions
Hold every objective for one full enemy turn

reinforcement from the Gate wound flank
